source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Run GPU stress tool (EX: Cuda example) or Diag (Ex: thermal) to heat system
2. Check if GPU with maximum Watts.
3. Set the all system fans speed to low. And check if GPU thermal to high , frequency should be get lower, BMC SEL have log about PROCHOT throttling and GPU power usage become lower in the same time
4. Power off system and recover fan controller.
5. Power on system and check if system work as normal. ( Ex: cd to file folder, cp files, network ... )
6. AC cycle system and check if system work as normal

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. GPU frequency should be maximum value when runnig GPU stress tool
2. GPU frequency and power usage should become lower when thermal throttling
3. BMC SEL should have log about GPU thermal throttling ???
4. System should power off without problem
5. System should power on without problem
6. System should work without problem after AC cycle
Note:need to see fan table spec caution1、2、3 value

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- PROCHOT Thermal Throttling (GPU): observe GPU PROCHOT throttling under a GPU stress: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "nvidia-smi -q -d CLOCK 2>&1 | grep -i -E "Gpu|Throttle"; nvidia-smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu,clocks.sm --format=csv 2>&1" while running a GPU benchmark.

original_test_intent: Induce controlled GPU thermal throttling at maximum load and reduced fan speed, prove simultaneous frequency/power reduction and the intended BMC event, then restore cooling and verify power/AC recovery and basic function.
original_method: A validated automated controller runs the approved GPU diagnostic, applies all-fan-low under hard limits, correlates UUID-specific temperature/clock/power/throttle/fan/SEL evidence, restores cooling during power-off, powers on, performs the approved AC cycle and checks host function.
manual_activity: No physical operation is prescribed. One-user approval and exceptional recovery availability do not make the normal workload, fan, telemetry, power and AC-control path partial.
required_inputs: GPU UUID/PCIe mapping, driver/firmware and authoritative throttle semantics
Approved CUDA/thermal workload and maximum-watt definition
Fan-table caution1/2/3 values, fan-low/restore controls and sensor map
Decision whether criterion 3 requires a specific BMC SEL entry and its exact event identity
Abort thresholds, approved power/AC recovery and one-user approval
safety_requirements: Continuously enforce GPU temperature/power and fan/OOB limits and stop on sensor loss or wrong UUID.
Do not infer fan table, GPU index, event name or throttle reason.
Restore and verify fan policy before recovery cycling.
Preserve the first anomaly and never automatically retry a thermal run.
agent_execution_scope: After approval, run the UUID-scoped workload/fan/monitoring workflow and capture full GPU/BMC evidence.
Correlate decreased clock and power with an authoritative throttle reason and any required SEL event.
Restore cooling, run approved power/AC recovery and basic file/network/host checks without issuing the verdict.
engineer_actions: Resolve the `???` SEL acceptance and fan-table caution values.
Approve workload, controls, safety limits and recovery.
Interpret final evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its telemetry fields may be supplemental after driver validation, but the literal nested quoting is unsafe and the command is not the source stimulus or complete evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Review the repository OOB script, use UUID-targeted supported nvidia-smi/diagnostic interfaces and validated BMC fan/power controls; retain all original source coverage.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: GPU maximum-power stress, all-fan-low, clock/power/SEL behavior, fan restoration, power/AC recovery, fan-table note and 20/60-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: QUALIFY OOB SCRIPT AFTER SEL/FAN-TABLE DECISION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use UUID-scoped continuous GPU temperature, clocks, power and throttle-reason telemetry synchronized with fan RPM/profile and BMC SEL, with atomic cooling restoration and external recovery control.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact GPU, driver, board, BMC and cooling implementation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record GPU VBIOS, driver/CUDA, BMC/CPLD, workload and script versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner GPU/platform thermal and fan-table specifications plus repository script revision.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds identity/evidence integrity and safe recovery without changing the intended stimulus.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No loss; read-only nvidia-smi alone is explicitly insufficient.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: UUID map, workload, fan table/control, SEL rule and aborts.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Throttle labels and available fields vary by GPU/driver, so version-specific mapping is mandatory.

project_override_considerations: A project may choose its validated GPU diagnostic, duration and AC mechanism, but must retain equivalent throttling evidence and state whether the unresolved SEL requirement was included. Omitted SEL coverage cannot be claimed.
expected_evidence: Approved GPU/BMC identity, workload, fan table/controls, SEL decision, limits, recovery and authorization
Time-aligned UUID-specific temperature/clock/power/throttle telemetry, workload and fan evidence
Required BMC SEL event or an explicit owner decision that it is not an acceptance criterion
Verified fan restoration, power/AC recovery, functional health and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The `???` and fan-table note mark unresolved acceptance inputs, but do not state two contradictory requirements. They require an engineer decision before execution.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The case remains technically coherent and automatable after the owner supplies fan-table and SEL semantics; absent project parameters do not create permanent BLOCKED status.
